TEXT.id: 7. Akay, kayokay rana na koman so nimay!
TEXT.citation: Rau, D. V., & Dong, M. N. (2006). Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary. Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica.
TEXT.BibTeX_citation: @book{rau2006yami, title={Yami texts with reference grammar and dictionary}, author={Rau, D Victoria and Dong, Maa-Neu}, year={2006}, publisher={Institute of Linguistics, Academia Sinica}}
TEXT.source: ['7. Akay, kayokay rana na koman so nimay!', '祖父，起來吃芋糕！', 'Grandpa, come eat taro cake!', '', 'si apen Ogaog (M, 69, Iranmilek)', '黃馬期，男，69，東清村', '']

S.FORM: yaken rana am, mina apia dang o kakawan a, k-aro namen a ka-k-anak-an a mi-al-alam do Jicinikcikan ito a.
S.PHON: jakən rana am mina apia ɖaŋ [o|u] kakawan a kar[o|u] namən a kakanakan a mialalam ɖ[o|u] ʥicinikcikan it[o|u] a
S.FORM: yaken rana am, mina apia dang o kakawan a, karo namen a kakanakan a mialalam do Jicinikcikan ito a.
S.PHON: jakən ɻana am mina apia ɖaŋ [o|u] kakawan a kaɻ[o|u] namən a kakanakan a mialalam ɖ[o|u] ʥiʨinikʨikan it[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 我呢，那天天氣很好，所以我們很多小孩子就都去Jicinikcikan遊玩
As for me, one day the weather was very good, and a lot of us children went to Jicinikcikan to play.

S.FORM: karaan na am, m-ángsah ko rana, ta ji ko á-kaha, to ko rana ngítkeh, ta mi ko rana m-itkeh koan ko am, to ko rana ngóli a.
S.PHON: karaan na am m*ŋʂaʁ k[o|u] rana ta ʥi k[o|u] *kaʁa t[o|u] k[o|u] rana ŋ*tkəʁ ta mi k[o|u] rana mitkəʁ k[o|u]an k[o|u] am t[o|u] k[o|u] rana ŋ*li a
S.FORM: karaan na am, mangsah ko rana, ta ji ko akaha, to ko rana ngitkeh, ta mi ko rana mitkeh koan ko am, to ko rana ngoli a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan na am maŋʂaɰ k[o|u] ɻana ta ʥi k[o|u] akaɰa t[o|u] k[o|u] ɻana ŋitkəɰ ta mi k[o|u] ɻana mitkəɰ k[o|u]an k[o|u] am t[o|u] k[o|u] ɻana ŋ[o|u]li a
S.TRANSL: 後來覺得無聊，想睡覺；我就想，還是回家去睡覺好了，於是就回家了
At the time I felt bored and sleepy. As I thought about it, I wanted to sleep, so I went home.

S.FORM: "ma-ngay ko pala jira Akay an" koan ko a, ka-to ko angay-an, "a ji ko manci-an, ji ko yokay-a".
S.PHON: maŋaj k[o|u] pala ʥira akaj an k[o|u]an k[o|u] a kat[o|u] k[o|u] aŋajan a ʥi k[o|u] mancian ʥi k[o|u] j[o|u]kaja
S.FORM: "mangay ko pala jira Akay an" koan ko a, kato ko angayan, "a ji ko mancian, ji ko yokaya".
S.PHON: maŋaj k[o|u] pala ʥiɻa akaj an k[o|u]an k[o|u] a kat[o|u] k[o|u] aŋajan a ʥi k[o|u] manʨian ʥi k[o|u] j[o|u]kaja
S.TRANSL: 途中我想＂去祖父家看看＂ ，我就去了。我想＂我要跟他說 。還是不要吵醒他的好＂
As I walked home, I thought, "I'll go to Grandpa's," and I went. "I'll tell him I'll not wake him up."

S.FORM: karaan am, "yokay-in ko si Akay saon, ta ya ni-mang-may si Ina" koan ko, ka-to ko angay-an ji akay ta icialaw a.
S.PHON: karaan am j[o|u]kajin k[o|u] ʂi akaj ʂa[o|u]n ta ja nimaŋmaj ʂi ina k[o|u]an k[o|u] kat[o|u] k[o|u] aŋajan ʥi akaj ta icialaw a
S.FORM: karaan am, "yokayin ko si Akay saon, ta ya nimangmay si Ina" koan ko, kato ko angayan ji akay ta icialaw a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am j[o|u]kajin k[o|u] ɕi akaj ʂa[o|u]n ta ja nimaŋmaj ɕi ina k[o|u]an k[o|u] kat[o|u] k[o|u] aŋajan ʥi akaj ta iʨialaw a
S.TRANSL: 後來我又想＂還是叫醒祖父吧，就說，我媽媽做了芋糕＂ ，就這樣，我去了祖父的家
"I'll wake him up, saying, Mom has made taro cake." I went with this thought.

S.FORM: karaan na am, "mo Akay!" koan ko am, ji pa mi-zi-ziak, ta m-itkeh ori a, "mo Akay!" "ikongo manga apo ko?"
S.PHON: karaan na am m[o|u] akaj k[o|u]an k[o|u] am ʥi pa miʐiʐiak ta mitkəʁ [o|u]ri a m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u]
S.FORM: karaan na am, "mo Akay!" koan ko am, ji pa miziziak, ta mitkeh ori a, "mo Akay!" "ikongo manga apo ko?"
S.PHON: kaɻaan na am m[o|u] akaj k[o|u]an k[o|u] am ʥi pa miririak ta mitkəɰ [o|u]ɻi a m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我去了之後，就喊道：＂祖父！＂ 可是他在睡覺，沒有回應；我就再喊一次：＂祖父！＂ ＂什麼事啊？孫子＂
When I arrived I shouted, "Grandpa!" He didn't reply because he was still asleep, so I cried again, "Grandpa!" "What is it, my grandson?"

S.FORM: "mo Akay!" "ikongo, mo panci-an yaken manga apo ko?" "ya ni-mang-may si Ina, t-om-anggah ka kono",
S.PHON: m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] m[o|u] pancian jakən maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] ja nimaŋmaj ʂi ina t[o|u]maŋgaʁ ka k[o|u]n[o|u]
S.FORM: "mo Akay!" "ikongo, mo pancian yaken manga apo ko?" "ya nimangmay si Ina, tomanggah ka kono",
S.PHON: m[o|u] akaj ik[o|u]ŋ[o|u] m[o|u] panʨian jakən maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] ja nimaŋmaj ɕi ina t[o|u]maŋgaɰ ka k[o|u]n[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂祖父！＂ ＂叫我有什麼事嗎，孫子＂ ，＂聽說我媽媽做了芋糕，請你上去吃＂
"Grandpa!" "What is it, my grandson?" "They said Mom made taro cake for you and invite you up to eat."

S.FORM: karaan am, ma-ngay ko rana do vahay namen a, ma-níring si Ina am, "ya ka rana ni-man-ngo ya, mo koimo, ka ji a-kaha pa ya?" koan na yaken a.
S.PHON: karaan am maŋaj k[o|u] rana ɖ[o|u] vaʁaj namən a man*riŋ ʂi ina am ja ka rana nimanŋ[o|u] ja m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] ka ʥi akaʁa pa ja k[o|u]an na jakən a
S.FORM: karaan am, mangay ko rana do vahay namen a, maniring si Ina am, "ya ka rana nimanngo ya, mo koimo, ka ji akaha pa ya?" koan na yaken a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan am maŋaj k[o|u] ɻana ɖ[o|u] faɰaj namən a maniɻiŋ ɕi ina am ja ka ɻana nimanŋ[o|u] ja m[o|u] k[o|u]im[o|u] ka ʥi akaɰa pa ja k[o|u]an na jakən a
S.TRANSL: 後來我就到家了，我媽說＂孩子，你怎麼這麼晚回來？還不想睡哦＂
When I got home, Mom said, "Why did you come back so late? Aren't you sleepy?"

S.FORM: "todey mapa-lalak so ra-rakeh "karaan na am, ni-totoaw-an na rana ni Akay a.
S.PHON: t[o|u]ɖəj mapalalak ʂ[o|u] rarakəʁ karaan na am nit[o|u]t[o|u]awan na rana ni akaj a
S.FORM: "todey mapalalak so rarakeh "karaan na am, nitotoawan na rana ni Akay a.
S.PHON: t[o|u]ɖəj mapalalak ʂ[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ kaɻaan na am nit[o|u]t[o|u]awan na ɻana ni akaj a
S.TRANSL: ＂你怎麼可以這樣欺騙老人家呢？＂ 才說完，祖父來了
"How dare you trick the elders?" Just as she said that, Grandpa came in.

S.FORM: "Ama kong a, ka ma-ngay jino, mo keypong?" "na ni-yokay yaken ni Apo ito a, angay do tey-ngato, ta ya ni-mang-may si ina koan na",
S.PHON: ama k[o|u]ŋ a ka maŋaj ʥin[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ na nij[o|u]kaj jakən ni ap[o|u] it[o|u] a aŋaj ɖ[o|u] təjŋat[o|u] ta ja nimaŋmaj ʂi ina k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: "Ama kong a, ka mangay jino, mo keypong?" "na niyokay yaken ni Apo ito a, angay do teyngato, ta ya nimangmay si ina koan na",
S.PHON: ama k[o|u]ŋ a ka maŋaj ʥin[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ na nij[o|u]kaj jakən ni ap[o|u] it[o|u] a aŋaj ɖ[o|u] təjŋat[o|u] ta ja nimaŋmaj ɕi ina k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: ＂親愛的爸爸好，你怎麼來了？＂ ＂是孫子把我叫醒的，他說媽媽做了芋糕，叫我上來（吃）＂
"Dear Dad, why have you come?" "Grandson woke me up, and he said you had made taro cake and invited me up."

S.FORM: "ya ji abo, Ama kong a, ya ji abo, mo keypong a, ji á-sta yaken a na ni-yokay ni tamazang ito a",
S.PHON: ja ʥi ab[o|u] ama k[o|u]ŋ a ja ʥi ab[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ʥi *ʂta jakən a na nij[o|u]kaj ni tamaʐaŋ it[o|u] a
S.FORM: "ya ji abo, Ama kong a, ya ji abo, mo keypong a, ji asta yaken a na niyokay ni tamazang ito a",
S.PHON: ja ʥi ab[o|u] ama k[o|u]ŋ a ja ʥi ab[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ʥi aʂta jakən a na nij[o|u]kaj ni tamaraŋ it[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: ＂沒有芋糕呢，親愛的爸爸，真不好意思，真的沒有呢，你看，我也被他叫醒了，真是的
"There is no taro cake, Dear Dad. Look at me, I have also been woken up by that naughty boy.

S.FORM: "ko ni-panci si Akay a ni-yokay", "ta mo todey yokay-i sia", "ya ni-mang-may si Ina" koan ko, "ásio todey mapa-lalak so ra-rakeh a, ásio ka ya?"
S.PHON: k[o|u] nipanci ʂi akaj a nij[o|u]kaj ta m[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaji ʂia ja nimaŋmaj ʂi ina k[o|u]an k[o|u] *ʂi[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj mapalalak ʂ[o|u] rarakəʁ a *ʂi[o|u] ka ja
S.FORM: "ko nipanci si Akay a niyokay", "ta mo todey yokayi sia", "ya nimangmay si Ina" koan ko, "asio todey mapalalak so rarakeh a, asio ka ya?"
S.PHON: k[o|u] nipanʨi ɕi akaj a nij[o|u]kaj ta m[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaji ɕia ja nimaŋmaj ɕi ina k[o|u]an k[o|u] aɕi[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj mapalalak ʂ[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ a aɕi[o|u] ka ja
S.TRANSL: ＂我已叫醒了祖父＂ ＂為什麼要叫醒他？＂ 我說＂媽媽做了芋糕＂ ＂你怎麼可以這樣欺騙老人家呢，你怎麼這樣？！＂
He told me about waking you, I asked him why he woke you and he said that I had made taro cake. I said how dare he tricked the elders."

S.FORM: "a ya abo an, ya abo, manga anak ko, a", "a ya ji abo, mo keypong a, ji ka ma-karilaw, mo keypong a, na todey yokay-a ni apo mo",
S.PHON: a ja ab[o|u] an ja ab[o|u] maŋa anak k[o|u] a a ja ʥi ab[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ʥi ka makarilaw m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a na t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaja ni ap[o|u] m[o|u]
S.FORM: "a ya abo an, ya abo, manga anak ko, a", "a ya ji abo, mo keypong a, ji ka makarilaw, mo keypong a, na todey yokaya ni apo mo",
S.PHON: a ja ab[o|u] an ja ab[o|u] maŋa anak k[o|u] a a ja ʥi ab[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ʥi ka makaɻilaw m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a na t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaja ni ap[o|u] m[o|u]
S.TRANSL: ＂沒有哦，真的沒有哦，孩子！那麼 ＂，＂是的，真的沒有芋糕，親愛的。你的孫子吵醒了你，真是不好意思＂
"Oh, there is none, my child? If there is not, then ""No, there is no taro cake. I am sorry that your grandson woke you up."

S.FORM: "ciaha, mo keypong a, si Apo ya todey yokay jiaken a, ko ka-teng-an na k-abo, manga anak ko am" "y-owsok ko rana, manga apo ko an".
S.PHON: ciaʁa m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ʂi ap[o|u] ja t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʥiakən a k[o|u] katəŋan na kab[o|u] maŋa anak k[o|u] am j[o|u]wʂ[o|u]k k[o|u] rana maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] an
S.FORM: "ciaha, mo keypong a, si Apo ya todey yokay jiaken a, ko katengan na kabo, manga anak ko am" "yowsok ko rana, manga apo ko an".
S.PHON: ʨiaɰa m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ a ɕi ap[o|u] ja t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʥiakən a k[o|u] katəŋan na kab[o|u] maŋa anak k[o|u] am j[o|u]wʂ[o|u]k k[o|u] ɻana maŋa ap[o|u] k[o|u] an
S.TRANSL: ＂沒關係，親愛的。是孫子來叫醒我的，我也不知道原來沒有芋糕。那麼我下去囉，親愛的孫子＂
"It's okay, dear. My grandson woke me up, and I didn't even know there was no taro cake. (But if there isn't any), then I'll just go home, Dear Grandson."

S.FORM: karaan na am, ma-'ayo rana ori a, a m-osok rana ori am, maka-logod am ma-zokot a om-osok a.
S.PHON: karaan na am maʔaj[o|u] rana [o|u]ri a a m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k rana [o|u]ri am makal[o|u]g[o|u]ɖ am maʐ[o|u]k[o|u]t a [o|u]m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k a
S.FORM: karaan na am, ma'ayo rana ori a, a mosok rana ori am, makalogod am mazokot a omosok a.
S.PHON: kaɻaan na am maʔaj[o|u] ɻana [o|u]ɻi a a m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k ɻana [o|u]ɻi am makal[o|u]g[o|u]ɖ am mar[o|u]k[o|u]t a [o|u]m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k a
S.TRANSL: 就這樣，他很失望的下去了。然後看到他低著頭駝著背的身影回去了
And he left the house disappointed. I watched his back as he walked back home with his head lowered and shoulders drooped.

S.FORM: "a ji ka ma-kasi, mo keypong, am ásio, mo keypong, ikong to ko ngmáy-a a ma-la-lahet a waka-wakay ito am", ma-'ayo a om-osok a.
S.PHON: a ʥi ka makaʂi m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ am *ʂi[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ ik[o|u]ŋ t[o|u] k[o|u] ŋm*ja a malalaʁət a wakawakaj it[o|u] am maʔaj[o|u] a [o|u]m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k a
S.FORM: "a ji ka makasi, mo keypong, am asio, mo keypong, ikong to ko ngmaya a malalahet a wakawakay ito am", ma'ayo a omosok a.
S.PHON: a ʥi ka makaɕi m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ am aɕi[o|u] m[o|u] kəjp[o|u]ŋ ik[o|u]ŋ t[o|u] k[o|u] ŋmaja a malalaɰət a wakawakaj it[o|u] am maʔaj[o|u] a [o|u]m[o|u]ʂ[o|u]k a
S.TRANSL: ＂真的不好意思呢，親愛的爸爸；但真的沒有芋糕呢，我們有的只是一些不好的地瓜，做不成糕點呢＂ ，就這樣，他很失望的回家去了
"Dear Dad, I'm so sorry. How can I make any taro cake when the only things in the house are a few lousy sweet potatoes?" He walked down disappointed.

S.FORM: "a todey yokay so ra-rakeh ta, wánja o ya na ni-akan ni akay mo a ka-to mo yokay-an sia".
S.PHON: a t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʂ[o|u] rarakəʁ ta w*nʥa [o|u] ja na niakan ni akaj m[o|u] a kat[o|u] m[o|u] j[o|u]kajan ʂia
S.FORM: "a todey yokay so rarakeh ta, wanja o ya na niakan ni akay mo a kato mo yokayan sia".
S.PHON: a t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʂ[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ ta wanʥa [o|u] ja na niakan ni akaj m[o|u] a kat[o|u] m[o|u] j[o|u]kajan ɕia
S.TRANSL: ＂怎麼可以這樣叫醒老人家，你看你祖父來（家裡）吃什麼，真是的！＂
How dare you get an old man up like this. What did your grandpa get to eat? Why did you wake him up? Jeez!"

S.FORM: "ya ko m-ai jia am, ya ko todey nibo ji Akay a yokay-in ang", do akma so sang a.
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] mai ʥia am ja k[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj nib[o|u] ʥi akaj a j[o|u]kajin aŋ ɖ[o|u] akma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ a
S.FORM: "ya ko mai jia am, ya ko todey nibo ji Akay a yokayin ang", do akma so sang a.
S.PHON: ja k[o|u] mai ʥia am ja k[o|u] t[o|u]ɖəj nib[o|u] ʥi akaj a j[o|u]kajin aŋ ɖ[o|u] akma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ a
S.TRANSL: ＂那是我要回來的時候臨時想到要去叫醒祖父的嘛＂ 。這是當時的情形
"I was going to come straight home, and going the grandpa's was a last minute decision." Just like that.

S.FORM: ika-doa na araw am, i-pang-may na rana ori, ta i-k-arilaw na ni-pa-lalak ko ang, do akma sang,
S.PHON: ikaɖ[o|u]a na araw am ipaŋmaj na rana [o|u]ri ta ikarilaw na nipalalak k[o|u] aŋ ɖ[o|u] akma ʂaŋ
S.FORM: ikadoa na araw am, ipangmay na rana ori, ta ikarilaw na nipalalak ko ang, do akma sang,
S.PHON: ikaɖ[o|u]a na aɻaw am ipaŋmaj na ɻana [o|u]ɻi ta ikaɻilaw na nipalalak k[o|u] aŋ ɖ[o|u] akma ʂaŋ
S.TRANSL: 第二天，我媽因為可憐祖父被我騙醒，所以她就特地為他做了芋糕；像這樣
The next day, my mom made taro cake for Grandpa because she was sorry about my trickery. Just like that.

S.FORM: ka-tey-má-rahet no k-anak-an ya a mang-alalas,
S.PHON: katəjm*raʁət n[o|u] kanakan ja a maŋalalaʂ
S.FORM: kateymarahet no kanakan ya a mangalalas,
S.PHON: katəjmaɻaɰət n[o|u] kanakan ja a maŋalalaʂ
S.TRANSL: 所以啊，小孩子欺騙老人家是件很糟糕的事情
Therefore it is really bad for a child to trick (elders).

S.FORM: ta todey yokay so ra-rakeh, ta ikong o angayan na no akma so sang am,
S.PHON: ta t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʂ[o|u] rarakəʁ ta ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] aŋajan na n[o|u] akma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ am
S.FORM: ta todey yokay so rarakeh, ta ikong o angayan na no akma so sang am,
S.PHON: ta t[o|u]ɖəj j[o|u]kaj ʂ[o|u] ɻaɻakəɰ ta ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] aŋajan na n[o|u] akma ʂ[o|u] ʂaŋ am
S.TRANSL: 像這樣隨便叫醒老人家的行為，實在是沒有意義（很無聊）
It makes no sense to wake up elders for no reasons like that.

S.FORM: ka-ji ani-níg-an no met-metdeh ya, ori rana ya na kavos-an no kava-kavavatanen ko a ya ko on-onong-an.
